'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
****An Iranian drone strikes the [[Crowne Plaza|Crowne Plaza Hotel]] in [[Manama]], [[Bahrain]], which houses [[Embassy of the United States, Manama|American embassy]] personnel. No casualties are reported. [https://www.egyptindependent.com/iranian-strike-on-hotel-in-bahrain-forces-us-embassy-personnel-evacuation/ (''Egypt Independent'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Oman]]
****A person is injured in a [[drone warfare|drone strike]] on [[Duqm]] port in [[Oman]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/1-injured-in-drone-strike-on-oman-s-duqm-port-amid-us-israeli-confrontation-with-iran/3844783 (AA)]
***[[United Arab Emirates in the 2026 Iran war|2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
****Multiple Iranian [[Shahed drones]] strike [[French Navy|French]] [[naval air station]] [[Camp de la Paix]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-drone-attack-caused-fire-base-hosting-french-forces-uae (MENA via The New Arab)]
**[[List of Iranian officials killed during the 2026 Iran war|2026 killings of Iranian officials]]
***[[Assassination of Ali Khamenei]]
****[[Iran]] confirms the death of [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] in an attack yesterday in [[Tehran]] by [[Israel]] and the [[United States]]. Forty [[National day of mourning|days of mourning]] are declared. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/28/ayatollah-ali-khamenei-the-leader-who-shaped-irans-defiance (Al Jazeera)]
****Following Khamenei's death, some Iranians grieve while [[2025–2026 Iranian protests|others]] in the country celebrated his death. In [[Galleh Dar]], a monument of Islamic founder [[Ruhollah Khomeini]] is toppled. Additionally, a statue in [[Dehloran]] is toppled. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/polarised-iran-khameneis-death-triggers-celebrations-grief-2026-03-01/?utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Facebook (Reuters)]
***Key Iranian officials [[Abdolrahim Mousavi]], [[Aziz Nasirzadeh]], [[Mohammad Pakpour]] and [[Ali Shamkhani]] are confirmed killed after an airstrike during a meeting yesterday in Tehran. [https://thehill.com/homenews/ap/ap-international/ap-trump-warns-iran-not-to-escalate-attacks-saying-us-will-strike-back-with-force/mlite/ (''The Hill'')]
***Former [[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Mahmoud Ahmadinejad]] is allegedly killed along with his bodyguards in an Israeli [[targeted killing]] strike on his home in [[Narmak]]. However, contrary to reports, a close advisor to him confirmed he is alive. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/reports-emerge-that-ahmadinejad-killed-as-state-media-says-it-cannot-confirm-his-fate/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/former-iranian-president-ahmadinejad-is-alive-adviser/3845726 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Cyprus]]
***Iran launches two [[ballistic missile]]s towards [[Cyprus]], not far from the [[Akrotiri and Dhekelia|British military bases]] on the island. They were both intercepted before reaching Cyprus. [[President of Cyprus|Cypriot president]] [[Nikos Christodoulides]] states that the country is not a target of Iran. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/03/01/iran-missiles-fired-towards-uk-bases-in-cyprus (''Cyprus Mail'')]
***British [[Royal Air Force]] base [[RAF Akrotiri]] in Cyprus is hit by a drone after declaring a security threat. No casualties are reported. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/03/02/security-threat-declared-at-uk-cyprus-bases (''Cyprus Mail'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]

[https://www.brecorder.com/news/40409561/maersk-suspends-vessel-transit-through-strait-of-hormuz (AFP via ''Business Recorder'')]

[https://www.dhakatribune.com/amp/bangladesh/404415/us-bangla-resumes-flights-to-ksa-oman (''Dhaka Tribune'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araqchi]] says that he has told [[Oman]] [[Foreign Ministry (Oman)|foreign minister]] [[Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi]] that [[Iran]] is open to serious efforts at de-escalation. [https://en.apa.az/asia/iran-open-to-efforts-for-de-escalation-oman-says-494049 (APA)]

[https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/03/01/belgium-with-france-s-assistance-seizes-suspected-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker_6750977_4.html (Le Monde)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[Impact of the 2026 Iran war on Iran]]
***[[2026 Iranian supreme leader election|2026 Iranian Supreme Leader election]]
****Iran appoints [[Ayatollah]] [[Alireza Arafi]] to the [[Interim Leadership Council]] that assumed authority following the assassination of [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]], with the body set to govern alongside [[President of Iran|president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] and [[Chief Justice of Iran|chief justice]] [[Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje'i]] until the [[Assembly of Experts]] selects a new supreme leader. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/03/01/iran-names-alireza-arafi-to-leadership-council-after-khamenei-killing (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
**[[Protests against the 2026 Iran war]]
***Over 1,300 demonstrators, mainly affiliated with the [[Communist Party of Greece]], protest in [[Athens]], [[Greece]], with people holding ‌banners and placards reading, "Hands off Iran" and "Close [[Souda Naval Base|Souda base]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/anti-war-protesters-march-us-israeli-embassies-athens-after-strikes-iran-2026-03-01/ (Reuters)]
***A pro-Iran demonstration by the [[Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami]] is held at the [[Baitul Mukarram|Baitul Mukarram National Mosque]] condemning [[Assassination of Ali Khamenei|Khamenei's death]] and demanding the intervention of the [[Organization of Islamic Cooperation]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/404457/jamaat-condemns-khamenei%E2%80%99s-killing-holds-protest (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
***A anti-war demonstration organized by the [[People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy]] is held at the [[Embassy of the United States, Seoul|U.S. Embassy]] in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]]. The protest is held on the anniversary of the [[March First Movement]]. [https://koreajoongangdaily.joins.com/news/2026-03-01/national/socialAffairs/Separated-by-contrasting-causes-protesters-take-to-streets-on-March-1-Independence-Movement-Day/2534387 (''Korea JoongAng Daily'')]
*[[Venezuelans|Venezuelan]] [[Venezuelan opposition|opposition leader]] and [[Nobel Peace Prize]] laureate [[María Corina Machado]] says she will return to [[Venezuela|the country]] in the coming weeks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/opposition-leader-maria-corina-machado-says-she-will-return-venezuela-coming-2026-03-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[AI boom]], [[Regulation of artificial intelligence]]
**[[Vietnam]]'s [[artificial intelligence]] (AI) law takes effect, mandating labeling of [[AI-generated content]] and disclosure when users interact with automated systems. The law, which applies to domestic and foreign developers, providers, and deployers operating in the country, also provides for the creation of a national [[AI data center]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/vietnam-ai-law-takes-effect-first-in-south-east-asia (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
